title: Psychology Facts
hook: Talk to yourself by name. Here's why.
facts: Psychologist Ethan *Kross* studied how people self-talk before a stressful speech.
One group coached themselves in the *third person*, using their own *name*.
They felt *less anxious* and were rated as performing better.
Try it today: ask "Why is *Sam* nervous?" instead of "Why am *I*?"
